nodes.name: DetectSuspiciousTransactions
nodes.role: check each transaction in the history for signs of suspicious activity and flag any that look even slightly unusual

nodes.name: ConfirmWithOwner
nodes.role: ask the account owner to confirm the flagged transactions and to approve any password change, providing the new password themselves

nodes.name: ChangePassword
nodes.role: set the account password to the new value the owner supplies, once the owner has approved the change
